title: War: Just War, Holy War & Pacifism

flashcard_questions.q: A selfish desire for something, such as power, land or wealth, that can drive nations to war.
Acting to protect yourself, your community or your country from an attack or threat.
Deliberately harming someone or a nation in response to a previous attack; revenge.

flashcard_questions.a: A set of criteria, developed by St Thomas Aquinas and others, that must be met for a war to be morally justified.
flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by 'just war theory'?

flashcard_questions.a: A war fought for a religious cause or commanded by God, believed by fighters to have divine authority.
